description: This file provides update-check helpers for an npm package, including functions to fetch update info from npm registries, compare versions, and trigger background update checks.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with a timeout, handling HTTP response and errors.

methods.name: fetchDistTags
methods.description: Fetches distribution tags from multiple npm registry URLs.

methods.name: buildUpdateInfo
methods.description: Builds an UpdateInfo object based on current version and registry tags.

methods.name: triggerUpdateCheck
methods.description: Initiates a background update check and logs if an update is available.

methods.name: getUpdateInfo
methods.description: Fetches current update information from npm registries.

methods.name: checkVersionExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific version exists in the npm registries.

methods.name: compareVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings numerically and lexically for prerelease segments.
